SPACE_SIBLING_REVIEW.md.text:
# Independent review: mathematical-space siblings

Reviewed report: `REPORT_2026-09-15_SPACE_SIBLING_HUNT.md`  
SHA256: `ba18632d45bb5ec424171e434685e73d2b5544a0df9908b2fbf444ffec87f726`

## Verdict

**ACCEPT_SCOPED_SOURCE_VERIFIED_DISCOVERY_AND_PREFLIGHT_ONLY.**

The Hall/Fock feature map has the correct Gaussian kernel and complex inner
product convention; applied to the already-derived quartic layer it gives an
exact common Gram family, including mixed terms.  It is correctly not
transferred to full theta layers.

The Shkalikov theorem is used only conditionally: it can yield a maximal
nonnegative invariant graph under its stated dissipativity, domain,
resolvent-closure, and compactness hypotheses, but supplies neither a
theta-built operator nor membership of the prescribed family.  The negative
control is used correctly to show why a generic graph theorem cannot force
membership.

The Ball et al. Schur/de Branges-Rovnyak mechanism is likewise a conditional
exact realization interface.  The report does not confuse its positive-kernel
premise with an actual construction.  A1/B1 and arithmetic-reciprocity
filters retain their already accepted narrow scopes.  No positive graph,
positive source mixture, V sign, or RH conclusion is promoted.

ARITHMETIC_RECIPROCITY_REVIEW.md.text:
# Independent review: arithmetic reciprocal assembly

Reviewed candidate: `ARITHMETIC_RECIPROCITY_CANDIDATE.md`  
SHA256: `e5f1477adc44d0b57a156c77db1e9492c477a9f623776ae6a6abcf86ce969795`

## Verdict

**ACCEPT_SCOPED_RECONSTRUCTION_AND_EVENTUAL_STRIP_LIMIT_ONLY.**

The simplex estimate has the stated constant and transfers from `r_M` to all
`r_N`, `N>=M`, by convolution with a positive remainder.  It yields the
`4M+1/2` logarithmic tail exponent for the reflected term.  Hence the
weighted L1 convergence on every fixed strip and the normalization of the
Fourier limit are valid.

The finite functions are entire source assemblies but their defining Fourier
integrals have exactly the stated open strip; the boundary absolute-divergence
claim follows from the positive tail asymptotic.  The Mellin identity and the
`N=1` formula have the correct factors.  This is distinct from the prior
geometric square-root construction; no prior source report found this same
assembly.  It has no zero-location, V-sign, or RH consequence.

SOURCE_REBUILD_REVIEW.md.text:
# Independent review: source rebuilding compatibility filters

Reviewed candidate: `SOURCE_REBUILD_PREFLIGHT.md`  
SHA256: `a3c9584270b34f79e2a0258d64aa27cbd723e23d06e8bc44e7582fb61f6ff1ff`

## Verdict

**ACCEPT_SCOPED_ASSEMBLY_FILTERS_ONLY.**

For a positive finite Gaussian sum, differentiating the exact half-line
kernel gives
`J11=-f(0)^2+2 integral t f'(t)^2 dt`; expanding it yields exactly
`-sum_{j,k} p_j p_k ((a_j-a_k)/(a_j+a_k))^2`.  The two-rate value is
`-2/9`, and the indicated two-node difference quotient converges to this
mixed derivative.  It correctly refutes preservation of the exact kernel
under positive direct source sums, while retaining the cross terms.

For the quartic mixture, finiteness at zero gives a finite positive measure;
a countable box has positive mass and supplies the polynomial-exponential
lower bound.  That contradicts the actual double-exponential theta tail.
The stated exclusions are limited to positive mixtures in this fixed
coordinate and do not imply an actual theta counterexample, a V-sign result,
or RH.

CRITICALSTRIP_INTAKE_REVIEW.md.text:
# Independent review: CRITICALSTRIP intake

Reviewed intake: `REPORT_2026-09-15_CRITICALSTRIP_INTAKE.md`  
SHA256: `f28495620937793b270bf28208019c0d3c6915cd4de00932fe48f351c37b6e21`

## Verdict

**ACCEPT_UNIFORM_GAMMA_ZERO_FREE_SLAB_INTAKE_ONLY.**

The intake faithfully records the accepted exact-gamma slab theorem:
`|M_N(u+i v)| >= 1/256` for every finite `N`, `|u|<=5`, and real `v`,
with C6 only for `R<=5`.  It does not promote the result to arbitrary-R C6,
V positivity, or RH.

The new arithmetic comparison is correct.  Its small-`t` expansion gives
`log H_N(x)=const-(4N+1/2)x+O_N(e^{-2x})` with the stated derivative control,
so `-(log H_N)'' -> 0` for each fixed N.  This identifies a lost curvature
mechanism only; it neither kills the arithmetic route nor asserts a Fourier
zero.
